provenance.notes: The other f16 fixtures all run K <= 64, where an f16 accumulator is indistinguishable from an f32 one. This one accumulates over K=512 so the tiled path's f32 accumulation is actually pinned.
A float16 request on an aligned subgroup-matrix shape widens activations to float32 around the multiply, accumulates in float32, and narrows the result afterward.
A five-row speculative-decoder multiply exercises the tiled route within the 2-to-15-row band, using a ragged K dimension and NF4 block-quantized weights.
